description: Add a new brand workspace under this login (Starter holds 1 brand, Studio 5, Pro 20). Returns the new brand id so you can pass it as brandId to setup_start, brand_save, drafts_create and every other tool. Ask the user for the brand name (and optional website) first.

name.description: Name of the new brand, 1 to 80 characters, such as "Casa Verde Florist".

website.description: Optional public https:// website address for the brand, up to 2048 characters. When given, its logo is imported automatically if found.

name: brands_create
title: Add a new brand
